name: Google Objectron: Object-Centric Video Dataset with 3D Bounding Boxes
description: Objectron is a large-scale collection of short object-centric video clips recorded in the wild with mobile phones, accompanied by 3D oriented bounding box annotations for every frame. Developed by Google Research, the dataset comprises 14,978 video sequences containing 4 million annotated images across nine everyday object categories, featuring synchronized camera poses, sparse point clouds, and planar surface ground truth.
